known_risks: RISK-006 (high): the mandatory baseline gate npm run test:server writes data/db.json, data/backups/*.json and logs/ into the repository, and bootstrap-plan.ps1 then THROWS on data/db.json. THE PLAN'S OWN DOCUMENTED FND-001 SEQUENCE CANNOT BE RUN TWICE without manual cleanup. Reproduced independently by the verifier. Full analysis and four remediation options recorded as DISC-001 in DECISIONS.md; awaiting user decision, deliberately not fixed inside FND-001 because the clean fix edits test infrastructure this package does not own.

RISK-001 (high): server/tests/bugfixes.test.js Discord-relay test has a hard 5000ms timeout and FAILS on a cold first run of the full server suite, then passes warm. Observed on the unmodified baseline. Any future agent running the gate cold on a fresh checkout will see a red suite and may misattribute it to their own change. The baseline is therefore green but NOT deterministic on first run.

RISK-002 (medium): data/db.example.json is stale relative to the authoritative schema in server/database/init.js defaultData. It carries 3 keys the schema does not define (activity_log, mods, active_server_id) and omits 14 the schema does define. Using it as the fixture basis for DB-001/DB-003 would produce an importer validated against the wrong shape.

RISK-003 (medium): FND-001 measured only one route (auth-status, unauthenticated). The plan's performance budgets reference representative routes generally; authenticated and I/O-bound routes have no baseline yet, so a future regression on those routes cannot be detected by comparison.

RISK-005 (medium): worktrees are prohibited until a user-authorized local checkpoint commit exists, because untracked handoff files do not appear in a new worktree. Until then FND-002, FND-003 and DB-001 cannot run in parallel and the program is serialized through the coordinator. Omitted from this array in the first draft and added after the independent verifier flagged the inconsistency against RISK_REGISTER.md and SUMMARY.md.

RISK-004 (low): the client build emits a >500 kB chunk advisory. Not a failure today, but the plan requires per-phase measurement of English bundle growth, and there is no recorded byte figure to grow from.
